# Introduction

This is a template for the [`dissertate`](https://github.com/jtkulas/dissertate) capability.

Advisors and advisees collaborate on the html version of the thesis/dissertation, with graduate--school format available via pdf download (right side--bar).

## Literature review 

Citations are specified in [BibTeX](https://www.overleaf.com/learn/latex/Bibliography_management_with_bibtex) or [BibLaTex](https://www.overleaf.com/learn/latex/Articles/Getting_started_with_BibLaTeX) format and stored within `.bib` file(s) located within your project directory. 

For example, see the work of @quarto and @knuth84
